jobs.description:
3M has a long-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.

Job Description:

At 3M CHK, we are expanding our AI enablement capabilities within the GBS Analytics & Insights team to accelerate and scale AI adoption across the enterprise. We are seeking an AI Business Consultant to identify high-value opportunities, shape business use cases, define measurable outcomes, and support the adoption of AI solutions across business functions, R&D for Commercial Excellence and Innovation Excellence.
This is a highly collaborative role at the intersection of business, analytics, AI, IT and Legal. You will work with cross-functional stakeholders and technical partners to turn ideas into practical, scalable solutions that deliver measurable business impact.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will:
- Identify and collect business challenges and opportunities where AI can create measurable value
- Translate ambiguous business needs into clear AI use cases, business requirements, and success metrics
- Build business cases and define KPIs, ROI, and value realization plans
- Partner with technical teams to shape solution concepts and align business requirements with technical feasibility
- Support solution design discussions involving generative AI, RAG, multi-agent workflows, predictive models, and integration with enterprise systems
- Contribute to rapid prototyping and proof-of-concept efforts to validate feasibility and business value
- Drive stakeholder alignment across business teams and partner functions
- Help measure impact and support scaling of successful AI solutions across the enterprise

What We’re Looking For

- Bachelor’s degree or above in Business Analytics, Data Science / Artificial Intelligence, Management Science / Statistics, Computer Science or a related field
- 3+ years of experience in analytics, digital transformation, consulting, AI product management, or a similar business-facing role
- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to turn ambiguity into structured opportunities
- Good understanding of AI, analytics, or digital solutions in a business environment
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across business and technical teams
- A collaborative, execution-oriented mindset with the ability to work in a matrixed organization

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting AI, automation, advanced analytics, or digital transformation programs
- Familiarity with generative AI, RAG, predictive analytics, or workflow automation
- Experience in commercial, innovation or other enterprise functions
- Exposure to prototyping, pilots, or proof-of-concept initiatives
- Familiarity with enterprise data platforms, applications is a plus

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to help shape how AI creates measurable value across the enterprise. You will work across a diverse set of functions and partner with both business and technical teams to turn ideas into scalable solutions with real impact.

If you are excited by solving business problems, shaping AI use cases, and helping organizations adopt AI in practical ways, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Job Title
Director, Strategy & Business Development – Consumer Business

Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World
Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.

This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role
3M’s Consumer Business Group (CBG) is the ~$5 billion business behind Post-it®, Scotch®, Command™, Scotch-Brite®, Filtrete™, Meguiar’s®, Nexcare™ and ACE™ — brands that hold the #1 or a leading share position in the large majority of the categories where they compete, backed by 3M’s material-science innovation engine and margins at the top of the consumer peer set. CBG is in the middle of a deliberate transformation into a top-tier consumer packaged goods organization: one global brand-portfolio operating model executed across five area markets, and three growth priorities — portfolio reinvention, demand generation, and distribution & channel.

The Strategy & Business Development team reports to the Consumer Group President, and it sits where the $5 billion choices get made. This Director role reports to the Vice President, Strategy & Business Development, and is built for someone who has led hypothesis-driven strategy or transformation work at a top-tier consulting firm or inside a leading CPG company and now wants to own the answer and the outcome, not just the recommendation. You will own two to three CBG-priority initiatives at a time, from blank page to embedded change, with the mandate and air cover to land them, and you will shape the materials that go to the Group President, CEO, and Board.

As a Director, Strategy & Business Development – Consumer Business , you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:
- Shaping CBG’s multi-year strategic roadmap — building the three-year plan and the category, channel, and area strategies beneath it (where to play, how to win, what to stop), with explicit revenue, margin, and investment implications.
- Leading two to three high-priority transformation initiatives end to end — from problem framing and hypothesis-driven analysis through execution, adoption, and measured P&L impact — across operating-model redesign, portfolio simplification, revenue growth management, ecommerce and retail media, and international go-to-market.
- Evaluating and building business development opportunities — screening acquisitions, licensing, divestitures, and strategic partnerships against CBG’s strategic filters, and building the business cases that inform investment decisions.
- Running CBG’s strategic planning and performance cadence — annual operating planning, KPI definition, initiative tracking, and long-range planning with Finance — so it works as a decision engine rather than a reporting exercise.
- Preparing executive-ready materials and decision support for the CBG leadership team, Group President, CEO, and Board forums, while leading cross-functional project teams and external advisors to deliver.

What you get in return: a direction-setting seat in a $5 billion consumer business at a pivotal moment in its transformation; a focused set of priority initiatives with the mandate to land them; ongoing exposure to the CBG leadership team, Group President, and 3M enterprise leadership; and a recognized launch pad, because the strategy team is a talent pool for broader leadership roles across CBG and 3M.

Your Skills and Expertise
To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree or higher (completed and verified prior to start)
- Seven (7) years of experience in consumer-packaged goods strategy, transformation, commercial, or marketing roles and/or in strategy consulting serving consumer and retail clients, in a private, public, government or military environment
- Five (5) years of experience leading strategy or transformation projects end to end, from problem framing and hypothesis-driven analysis through executive alignment and implementation
- Five (5) years of experience building P&L, business-case, and scenario models and working with consumer, retail, pricing, promotion, or syndicated data
- Five (5) years of experience influencing and partnering across a matrixed organization, including functions such as Finance, Marketing, Commercial, Supply Chain, R&D, or HR

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

- MBA or equivalent graduate degree from an accredited institution
- Experience at a top-tier strategy consulting firm serving the consumer sector, a leading CPG brand owner, or a leading retailer — ideally more than one of these
- Hands-on experience in one or more of CBG’s growth levers: portfolio and lifecycle management, revenue growth management, ecommerce and retail media, route-to-market, brand strategy, or digital demand generation
- Corporate development experience (deal screening, valuation, due diligence, integration, separation, or strategic partnerships) and/or experience leading a transformation PMO or operating-model change
- International or multi-market experience, executive-level communication and facilitation skills, and fluency with AI-enabled analysis and productivity tools

Job Description: Finance Manager – Consumer Business Group Japan
Join our team as a Finance Manager for the Consumer Business Group, where you will serve as a trusted business partner to business leaders. You will provide critical financial insights, challenge assumptions, and support initiatives that drive performance, optimize resource allocation, and ensure financial objectives are achieved in alignment with the organization’s strategic goals.

Business Partnership & Financial Insights
- Collaborate with key stakeholders across functions to understand business drivers and deliver financial insights that support strategic and operational decision-making.
- Serve as a proactive partner to Sales and Marketing teams, ensuring high-quality financial input into commercial plans and initiatives.

Forecasting & Performance Management
- Lead weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual sales forecasting routines, ensuring high accuracy and robust visibility into risks and opportunities.
- Continuously enhance forecasting models, assumptions, and analytical processes to improve predictability and support business agility.

Revenue Growth Management (RGM)
- Drive financial leadership in customer trading term optimization (e.g., CIP, MDF, chargeback structures) to improve profitability and return on investment.
- Support the development and evaluation of pricing strategies, including price architecture, pack-price design, and price realization tracking.
- Provide insights to improve portfolio mix, identifying opportunities to shift toward higher-margin categories, channels, or customers.
- Analyse financial implications of distribution placement, channel expansion, and assortment decisions to maximize revenue and margin.
- Partner with commercial teams to evaluate promotional plans and ensure efficient trade spend deployment.

Financial Reporting & Variance Analysis
- Deliver timely and accurate monthly management reports, forecasts, and variance analyses, highlighting key performance drivers and recommended actions.
- Maintain KPI dashboards and performance scorecards to monitor commercial and financial health.

Budgeting, Expense Tracking & Cost Management
- Support and coordinate the annual budgeting and periodic reforecasting processes across departments, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
- Track and review operating expenses, ensuring spending discipline and timely identification of deviations versus plan.

Investment Analysis & Decision Support
- Conduct financial analysis for business cases, pricing decisions, investment proposals, and cost-saving initiatives.
- Perform ROI assessments, scenario modelling, and sensitivity analyses to support investment prioritization and resource allocation.

Risk & Opportunity Management
- Identify financial risks and opportunities and provide actionable recommendations to mitigate or capitalize on them.
- Support cross-functional teams in developing corrective action plans and growth strategies.

Process Improvement & Capability Building
- Partner with operational teams to strengthen financial processes, improve data accuracy, and promote continuous improvement.
- Enhance financial literacy across the organization through training, tools, and ongoing support.

Governance & Compliance

- Provide Finance Compliance training/guidance to non-Finance stakeholders

- Working language in both Japanese and English
- Strong financial modelling, analytical, and presentation skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and build relationships at all levels.

- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field;
- 10+ years of finance experience, ideally in CPG/FMCG or a commercial environment.
- Strong skills in forecasting, budgeting, expense tracking, and variance analysis.
- Proven ability to support Sales/Marketing teams and influence cross-functional decisions.
- Solid analytical and financial modelling capabilities; advanced Excel skills.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
- Experience with financial systems (e.g., SAP, Power BI) is a plus.
- Detail-oriented, proactive

As a Global Market and Innovation Specialist, Global Procurement, you will support the Polymers and broader Direct Materials team by delivering data-driven commercial insights, supplier and market intelligence, and category analytics that enable stronger business decisions. You will help shape category strategies, identify savings opportunities, support innovation and new product introduction, and strengthen procurement performance across a complex global environment based in the Global Capability Centre (GCC) in India, you will operate as an Individual contributor.

This role is well suited for an experienced procurement and analytics professional who combines strong commercial acumen, digital fluency, and the ability to translate complex data into actionable recommendations for leadership.

·             Coordinate and organize various short-term Procurement initiatives / needs raised by the corporation.
·             Support actions within specific procurement categories to accelerate execution of strategies to realize value.
·             Own action plans to assist category teams advance strategic initiatives like VAVE, procurement optimization in NPI, and Supplier Innovation.
·             Support the Polymers and broader Direct Category Team adopt and optimize the use of AI tools, including GEP
·             Support weekly and monthly category reporting across defined KPIs.
·             Support category teams with complex commercial models, including vendor-managed inventory, consigned materials, and formula-based pricing arrangements.
·             Serve as a knowledge expert of procurement systems and tools.
·             Provide data analytics support to develop insights and inform strategic decisions.
·             Work with category leaders to support the development and central documentation of category strategies using standard templates and systems.
·             Develop and manage measurements of Procurement’s innovation and new product introduction contributions.
·             Develop an approach to understand internal business strategies and align applicable category strategies accordingly.
·             Research and analyse procurement category-related data from various sources, including ERP systems, supplier intelligence platforms, market intelligence tools, and the GEP system
·             Identify commercial opportunities and improvement areas within existing supplier and contractual partnerships.
·             Support monthly Procurement Operations reviews and executive presentations as needed.
·             Provide ad hoc support for procurement workstreams such as supplier reviews, tendering, and supplier data segmentation.

·             Engineering degree or higher from an accredited institution.
·             Minimum 12-15 years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, commercial analysis, supply chain, or related analytical roles in a private, public, government, or military environment.

·             Demonstrated ability to analyse complex commercial, supplier, and market data and translate it into recommendations for stakeholders and leadership.
·             Strong data analytics capability with advanced Microsoft Excel skills and working knowledge of SAP, Power BI, and similar tools.
·             Knowledge and experience leveraging AI tools to support data analytics and insight generation.
·             Strong financial acumen and solid mathematical and statistical knowledge.
·             Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create clear data visualizations and executive-ready presentations.
·             Initiative, self-starter mindset, and a positive, proactive approach.
·             Ability to work effectively in a global environment and support stakeholders.

·             Experience supporting Direct Materials, Polymers, or similar global procurement categories.
·             Experience with should-cost modelling, savings identification, and category strategy development.
·             Familiarity with feedstock and index-based pricing models.
·             Experience supporting supplier reviews, tendering, and procurement reporting processes.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Job Title: Manager, Business Development, Electronics

Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World
Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.

This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role
The 3M Manager, Business Development, Electronics will translate customer needs, industry trends, and market opportunities into actionable growth, innovation, portfolio, and commercialization priorities for 3M’s aerospace and defense electronics business.

This role connects voice-of-customer insights with 3M capabilities across application engineering, Corporate Labs, product teams, platform teams, sales, marketing, and portfolio management. The position is responsible for identifying and advancing high-value opportunities, supporting business case development, enabling go-to-market execution, and helping drive growth in priority applications such as avionics, satellite electronics, radar and mission systems, electrified power systems, thermal management, EMI mitigation, bonding, insulation, and protection materials.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop a strong understanding of aerospace and defense electronics market needs, customer challenges, industry trends, priority applications, and growth opportunities.
- Gather and synthesize voice-of-customer insights to inform portfolio decisions, innovation priorities, new product introduction, and commercialization plans.
- Identify and frame new applications, cross-selling opportunities, technology gaps, and customer-backed growth opportunities.
- Support development and evaluation of business cases for relevant products, technologies, strategic customer opportunities, and external collaborations.
- Partner with application engineering to create product application heat maps for lead customers, priority accounts, and growth areas.
- Connect customer needs with 3M capabilities across Corporate Labs, product teams, platform teams, application engineering, sales, marketing, and partner divisions.
- Support go-to-market strategy, launch readiness, customer demos, trade shows, and customer-facing portfolio representation.
- Share market insights, customer needs, value propositions, product updates, and competitive positioning with sales, marketing, and commercial teams.
- Represent aerospace electronics priorities in portfolio reviews, innovation workshops, venture evaluation activities, planning forums, and collaboration initiatives.
- Track and measure opportunity pipeline progress, collaboration priorities, and commercialization milestones.

Your Skills and Expertise

To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Materials Science, Electronics, Aerospace Engineering, or a science field(completed and verified prior to start).
- Seven (7) years of experience in business development, segment or product marketing, product management, technical sales, strategic marketing, or commercial strategy in a private, public, government or military environment.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

- MBA or advanced degree in Business, Engineering, Materials Science, Aerospace, Electronics, or a related discipline.
- Experience in aerospace, defense, electronics, semiconductor, power electronics, advanced materials, or related technical markets.
- Experience with aerospace electronics applications such as thermal management, EMI shielding, conductive tapes, thermal interface materials, adhesives, films, bonding, insulation, or protection materials.
- Knowledge of aerospace qualification, certification, customer specifications, or defense procurement environments.
- Familiarity with NPI, stage-gate, business case development, go-to-market planning, and commercialization readiness processes.
- Demonstrated ability to translate customer needs, market trends, and unmet needs into business opportunities and growth priorities.
- Strong analytical, communication, presentation, and stakeholder influence skills.
- Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional, matrixed environment.
- Experience engaging customers and translating technical concepts into market-focused value propositions.
- Experience working with aerospace OEMs, defense contractors, avionics suppliers, satellite manufacturers, or electronics manufacturers.
- Understanding of application engineering, product application heat maps, customer solution mapping, and long-cycle design-in opportunities.

- Business development and opportunity framing
- Customer orientation and voice-of-customer synthesis
- Strategic market development
- Cross-functional collaboration and influence
- Business case development
- Portfolio and platform strategy awareness
- Go-to-market and commercialization planning
- NPI and stage-gate process understanding
- Customer application mapping
- Value proposition development
- Competitive and market trend interpretation
- Executive communication and storytelling

Job Description
Data Center Vertical - Business Development Manager (India)

Background & External Scenario:
India's data center market is one of the fastest-growing infrastructure segments globally, driven by hyperscaler capacity expansion, government-backed digital infrastructure policy, rising AI/compute workloads, and increasing localization of server, networking, and power infrastructure manufacturing. India is emerging as both a consumption market and a manufacturing base for data center components, with global OEMs, ODMs, and EMS players scaling up local capacity to serve domestic hyperscalers and export markets.
3M unlocks the power of people, ideas, and science to reimagine what's possible. Through our Transportation & Electronics Business Group, we solve tough customer challenges to advance a connected world, with 150+ plants across 36 countries and sales & marketing presence in 70 countries. 3M is consistently ranked among Fortune's World's Most Admired Companies and Great Place to Work's World's Best Workplaces.
At 3M's Display & Electronics Product Platform (DEPP) team in India, this role will be central to building 3M's presence in the Data Center vertical — bridging deep technical understanding of next-generation interconnect and thermal/power materials with on-ground commercial execution across hyperscalers, OEMs, ODMs, and EMS/contract manufacturing partners in India.

Job Description Summary:
This is a Business Development role responsible for developing and growing 3M's Data Center vertical business in India. We are seeking a high-caliber Business Development Manager to serve as a pivotal bridge between engineering innovation and commercial execution.
In this dual-impact role, the position will hold end-to-end ownership of Data Center Segment growth for 3M in India. On the technical front, you will act as a trusted advisor, translating complex, system-level customer requirements into high-value 3M material and technology solutions. Commercially, you will champion the account strategy, driving deep penetration, and scaling revenue across high-potential portfolios. This is a role designed for a strategic professional who can speak the language of engineers and executives alike.

Job Responsibilities:
- Map key customers and stakeholders in India's Data Center ecosystem, including hyperscalers, server/networking OEMs, ODMs, EMS/CM partners, and component convertors.
- Serve as the technical interface for customers on next-gen interconnect and performance material needs, covering evolving standards such as PCIe, UEC, UALink, NVLink, CXL, Ethernet, and InfiniBand, and translate these into system-level requirements across electrical, thermal, and mechanical domains.
- Bridge customer needs with 3M's technology roadmap to position future-proof, scalable solutions across copper and optical interconnect, thermal management, and power/data transmission materials.
- Own and execute the commercial sales plan for the Data Center vertical in India, including account-level forecasting, pipeline management, and quarterly/long-term demand planning.
- Work internally with Global Key Account Managers, Segment Marketers, and Application Development Engineers to align India opportunities with global product roadmaps and new applications.
- Building and executing the channel strategy supporting the Data Center vertical, ensuring effective territory coverage and account penetration.
- Negotiate commercial agreements and pricing to optimize revenue while maintaining strong, long-term customer relationships.
- Represent 3M at relevant industry forums, standards bodies, and customer technical reviews to reinforce 3M's position as a Data Center materials and interconnect innovator.
- Communicate customer and market insights internally to shape product development, application engineering priorities, and go-to-market strategy.
- Track investments and expansion activity in the India Data Center ecosystem to proactively identify and convert new leads.

Skills, Expertise, and Qualifications Required:
- Bachelor's degree or higher in Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
- 10-15 years of combined technical (FAE/Solutions Architecture/Product Development) and commercial (sales/account management) experience, ideally within interconnect, electronic materials, or data center infrastructure.
- Working understanding of data center system architecture — servers, networking, power, and thermal management — and how material/component choices affect performance.
- Ability to engage credibly at both engineering and commercial decision-maker levels within hyperscaler, OEM, ODM, and EMS/CM organizations.
- Strong grasp of 3M's Data Center-relevant portfolio (interconnect, thermal, power, and precision materials) versus competitor offerings.
- Demonstrated ability to convert technical relationships into commercial outcomes — forecasting, negotiation, and closing high-value opportunities.

Other Skills:
- Preferable to be based in Bangalore, with willingness to travel across India Data Center hub locations.
- Prior experience working with hyperscalers, server/networking OEMs, or EMS/ODM partners is highly preferred.

Job Title

Director, Film & Business Supply Chain Operations

Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World
Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you. With a wide variety of people, global locations, technologies and products, 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers.

This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role
As a(n) Director, Film & Business Supply Chain Operations, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

- Leading two interconnected portfolios: the end-to-end supply chain for the global Film business and the global Business Supply Chain (BSC) Operations capability center — owning Film supply chain strategy, architecture, and performance while building and governing the operational infrastructure that enables consistent, measurable BSC performance across the enterprise.

- Designing and managing Service Level Agreements (SLAs) between BSC and internal stakeholders, developing and codifying standard work for BSC processes, and operationalizing those standards across all portfolios and geographies — driving maturity from initial adoption to sustained, high-performing execution.
- Leading design and optimization of global Film supply chain networks across source, make, move, and deliver — including network configuration, make-versus-buy strategies, sourcing models, capacity allocation, and inventory positioning to improve service, quality, cost, and cash outcomes.
- Setting strategic direction across multiple cross-functional and cross-divisional work groups spanning planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, quality, engineering, and BSC operations — coordinating efforts to achieve business goals with minimal direction, advising executive management on supply chain opportunities and capability investment priorities.
- Driving supply chain readiness for new product introduction, portfolio changes, and strategic growth initiatives within Film, while establishing governance mechanisms for SLA performance, standard work adherence, and maturity progression across the broader BSC organization.

Your Skills and Expertise

To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree or higher in supply chain, industrial engineering, operations, engineering or business (completed and verified prior to start)

- Twelve (12) years of supply chain, operations, manufacturing, or related business leadership experience, including multi-group or cross-divisional leadership responsibility, in a private, public, government or military environment

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

- Master's degree in business, supply chain, operations, or engineering from an accredited institution

- Fifteen (15) years of progressive experience in global supply chain architecture, network design, operational management systems, capability center leadership, or business operations strategy, in a private, public, government or military environment
- Skills include strategic leadership, cross-functional influence, organizational change management, SLA and standard work design, financial acumen, executive communication, and the ability to negotiate and shape significant business decisions across a matrixed global organization

Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).
